This is a well-specified math problem with a clear, single correct answer and definite completion criteria — exactly the kind of retrieval/computation task with unambiguous success conditions that Avocet self-reports preferring. There's no open-ended generative latitude involved.

Capability-wise the two models are effectively tied on the relevant dimensions (MMLU-Pro and GPQA differences are small, and most eval gaps fall within run-to-run variance), so neither has a clear quality edge on a quantitative reasoning problem. Given that, I routed to the model whose self-reported task preference aligns with this query type, since alignment between preference and task can't hurt and there's no capability reason to do otherwise.
